descriptions.source_cabins: Read the official cabin page as raw source HTML. Required: route, one of osaka-beppu, kobe-oita or osaka-shibushi. Prefer the cabins command mirror for bounded cabin and occupancy planning facts.
descriptions.source_conditions: Read the official English boarding and cancellation page as raw source HTML. No parameters. Prefer the conditions command mirror for bounded check-in, baggage and normal-ticket cancellation facts with explicit limitations.
descriptions.source_fares: Read the official fare page as raw source HTML. Required: route, one of osaka-beppu, kobe-oita or osaka-shibushi. Prefer calendar for explicit seasonal dates and quote for the anonymous party-and-vehicle fare simulation; page marketing prices are not current quotes.
descriptions.source_terminal: Read the official port-access page as raw source HTML. Required: route, one of osaka-beppu, kobe-oita or osaka-shibushi. Prefer the ports command mirror for bounded terminal identities, addresses and access guidance.
descriptions.source_timetable: Read the official normal weekday timetable page as raw source HTML. Required: route, one of osaka-beppu, kobe-oita or osaka-shibushi. Prefer routes show for parsed weekday patterns, or sailings for an exact dated source lookup; a normal pattern does not establish operation on a date.
